title: 第1794章 两仪剑阵第1793章 以一敌二
lines: 洪九催动的是云海宗四大剑诀之一，唯一的近战剑诀的秋风剑诀。
虽然名为秋风，但招式凌厉炽烈，三十丈之内如坠火炉。
叶风面对洪九催动的秋风剑诀不退反进，同时手中的紫青神剑朝天画圆。
一个旋转的太极图立刻出现在他的头顶，将当头落下的火焰剑气尽数绞入其中。
那些火焰剑气在旋转的太极图中，被撕扯得支离破碎，化作漫天火星散落。
但紧接着第二波剑气便到了，洪九的元力如同永无止境般灌注在焚天神剑之上，剑气一道接着一道，连绵不绝。
就在叶风全力应对洪九漫天火线的时候，云霜儿以快剑攻来。
叶风倒转紫青神剑，化解云霜儿的攻势。
三人斗法到现在，只是几个呼吸，所有的事儿都发生在电光石火之间。
叶风单手持剑，以一敌二，虽然开始时稍显压力，但很快他的潜力与速度便挖掘出来，面对二人夹击，竟不落下风。
叶风的剑越来越快，场中他的身影闪烁不定，仿佛十几个叶风同时在与二人交手。
这当然不是叶风的分身，而是叶风的速度太快所留下的残影。
双方开始陷入了僵持。
大概半盏茶后，叶风竟然从防守开始反击。
这种攻守易型的转变，让洪九与云霜儿都大为吃惊。
他们二人联手，竟然在近战中都无法彻底的压制住叶风！
“霜儿师妹，两仪剑阵！”
洪九见势不妙，立刻大声呼喊。
云海宗有神通妙法数百种，但每个云海宗弟子必学的却是一诀二真三阵四剑。
其中三阵指的是两仪剑阵，七星剑阵，天罡剑阵。
云海宗每一个弟子，之所以都要学习剑阵，是为了多人斗法或者大规模冲突做准备的。
当年甲子猎仙，天界与人间投入了上百万修士，如此大规模的斗法，个人的修为与战力已经不重要了。
就像百万大军厮杀，拼的是阵型与调度，不是个人的勇武。
甲子猎仙之后，正魔各门派便开始修改制度，将阵法当作弟子的必修课。
云海宗的这三个法阵，两仪剑阵是两人催动的。
七星剑阵是七人催动的。
这两个剑阵是应对小规模斗法。
而天罡剑阵就非常可怕了，至少需要九个人才能催动，且没有上限。
也就是说，九个云海宗弟子可以催动天罡剑阵，九百，九千，甚至九万名云海宗弟子也可以一起催动天罡剑阵。
content_en:
What Hong Jiu activated was the Autumn Wind Sword Technique, one of the four major sword techniques of the Yunhai Sect and the only close combat sword technique.
Although it is called Autumn Wind, its moves are so fierce and fierce that within thirty feet it is like falling into a furnace.
Ye Feng faced the Autumn Wind Sword Technique urged by Hong Jiu and advanced instead, while at the same time drawing a circle in the sky with the purple-green divine sword in his hand.
A rotating Tai Chi figure immediately appeared above his head, twisting all the flaming sword energy that fell on his head into it.
Those flaming sword energy were torn to pieces in the rotating Tai Chi diagram, turning into sparks scattered all over the sky.
But then the second wave of sword energy arrived, and Hong Jiu's energy poured into the Burning Sky Divine Sword like it was endless. The sword energy was one after another, continuous.
Just when Ye Feng was dealing with Hong Jiu's line of fire with all his strength, Yun Shuang'er attacked with a quick sword.
Ye Feng reversed the Purple Green Divine Sword and neutralized Yun Shuang'er's offensive.
The three of them had been fighting for just a few breaths, and everything happened in a flash.
Ye Feng held the sword in one hand, fighting one against two. Although he was a little stressed at the beginning, his potential and speed were soon discovered, and he was not at a disadvantage when faced with the attack of the two.
Ye Feng's sword became faster and faster, and his figure flickered in the field, as if a dozen Ye Feng were fighting against the two of them at the same time.
This is of course not Ye Feng's clone, but the afterimage left by Ye Feng's speed.
The two sides began to fall into a stalemate.
After about half a cup of tea, Ye Feng actually started to fight back from defense.
This change in offensive and defensive patterns surprised both Hong Jiu and Yun Shuang'er.
The two of them joined forces and were unable to completely suppress Ye Feng in close combat!
"Junior Sister Shuang'er, Liangyi Sword Formation!"
Seeing that the situation was not good, Hong Jiu immediately shouted loudly.
The Yunhai Sect has hundreds of magical powers, but what every Yunhai Sect disciple must learn is the One Technique, Two True Forms, Three Formations and Four Swords.
The three formations refer to the Liangyi Sword Formation, the Seven Star Sword Formation, and the Tiangang Sword Formation.
The reason why every disciple of Yunhai Sect must learn the sword formation is to prepare for multi-person fights or large-scale conflicts.
During the Jiazi hunt for immortals, millions of monks were invested in heaven and earth. In such a large-scale battle, personal cultivation and combat prowess were no longer important.
It's like a million-strong army fighting in battle. What matters is formation and coordination, not individual bravery.
After Jiazi's Immortal Hunting, the various sects of Zhengmo began to modify their systems, making formations a compulsory course for their disciples.
The three formations of Yunhai Sect and the Liangyi Sword Formation were activated by two people.
The Seven Star Sword Formation was activated by seven people.
These two sword formations are for small-scale battles.
The Tiangang Sword Formation is very terrifying. It requires at least nine people to activate it, and there is no upper limit.
In other words, nine Yunhai Sect disciples can activate the Tiangang Sword Formation, and nine hundred, nine thousand, or even 90,000 Yunhai Sect disciples can also activate the Tiangang Sword Formation together.
title_en: Chapter 1794 Liangyi Sword Formation Chapter 1793 One vs. Two
